title: Home-Site Lease Clause: Business Days, Calendar Days and the Cure Deadline
content:
**Clause — how the cure days of a Home-Site Lease nonpayment notice run on the calendar**

1. How the lengthened cure period runs on the calendar follows the channel of the latest payment on the lease:
   - when it came through the community office — a money order, a cashier's check or a personal check handed to the office — the days are office business days, Monday through Friday, because office payments can only be made on those days;
   - when it came through the resident portal — from a bank account or by card — the days are calendar days, and a deadline that would fall on a Saturday or Sunday moves to the following Monday;
   - otherwise the days are calendar days as counted.
2. However the cure days are counted, the count starts the day after the notice date, and a payment received on the deadline day itself is in time.

The latest payment is the single most recent payment received on the lease. "Otherwise" covers a latest payment through any other channel, such as an automatic ACH draft, and a lease with no payment on record.

**Clause 1 illustrated (hypothetical: a cure period of 10 days, notice dated Wednesday 6 May 2026)**

| Channel of the latest payment | Days run as | Cure deadline | Calendar days from the notice date to the deadline |
|---|---|---|---|
| community office | Monday-to-Friday days: 7, 8, 11, 12, 13, 14, 15, 18, 19, 20 May | Wednesday 20 May 2026 | 14 |
| resident portal | calendar days to Saturday 16 May, moved to the following Monday | Monday 18 May 2026 | 12 |
| any other, or none | calendar days as counted | Saturday 16 May 2026 | 10 |

**More dates (hypothetical)**

- A notice dated Saturday 9 May 2026 with a cure period of 7 days and an office payment as the latest payment: business days Monday 11 May through Tuesday 19 May; the deadline is Tuesday 19 May, 10 calendar days after the notice date.
- A notice dated Monday 4 May 2026 with a cure period of 13 days and a portal payment as the latest payment: the thirteenth calendar day is Sunday 17 May, so the deadline moves to Monday 18 May, 14 calendar days after the notice date.

Under clause 2, a payment received on the deadline day itself — 20 May in the office case above — is in time.
